responses.text: I see my services are required once more. It's about time.
Oh my. This place is filthy.
It's amazing how much dust collects if you leave things alone even for a short while.
Really, someone should have called me earlier.
This room is even worse than the last one.
What have you savages been doing here?
Ah, a job well done is it's own reward. Good riddance to this rubbish.
